inputs.goal: hire a senior backend engineer who can own our payments service

define-role.intake.summary: Need to define role requirements and responsibilities for senior backend engineer focused on payments service

draft.summary: Design, develop, and maintain our payments processing system as the lead engineer.
responsibilities: Own the entire backend payments service infrastructure
Ensure high availability, performance, and security of payments systems
Integrate with third-party payment processors and services
Collaborate with frontend and mobile teams for seamless integrations
Mentor junior engineers on backend best practices
requirements: Proven experience as a senior backend engineer
Expertise in building and maintaining payments systems
Strong knowledge of payment processing, security standards (PCI-DSS)
Proficiency in Node.js, Python, or other backend languages
Experience with databases like PostgreSQL and NoSQL stores
